caption: The video captures a nighttime outdoor scene on dim reddish-brown ground, where a silhouetted person stands near the center with arms raised overhead. From the raised hands, bright orange-yellow sparks throw outward in a wide fan, forming an arcing canopy above the figure. The spray flickers across the black background while elongated spark streaks fall through the scene, including a bright trail descending toward the lower right. The person remains largely in place, showing only slight sway and rotation of the torso and arms. A dark rock sits to the left, and a thin vertical trail of sparks plus a small glowing patch remain below the person's feet. The framing shifts gradually, with ground features moving relative to the image edges as the subject occupies slightly more of the view.
relations: Sparks emitted from the raised hands fan outward and arc into a canopy above the figure.
Falling spark streaks descend through the scene, including a bright trail toward the lower right.
The person stays near center with only slight torso and arm sway while sparks continue to spray.
Gradual framing shift moves ground features and the dark rock relative to the image edges.
